_comment: Dry-run corpus for `python -m src.cli.run_batch --dry-run`. Stands in for live N1 discovery and (where signals/contact are pre-filled) for N2 enrichment, so the whole graph can be exercised offline with no API keys. Covers every region, both niche families, and the awkward cases each node has to handle.

signals: no online booking - phone number only on the contact page
Google listing shows 34 reviews with no owner responses since 2024
site is not mobile responsive below 480px
leads._expect: email-only (no linkedin_url) -> N3.5 must choose 'email' despite any niche default

signals: booking widget 404s on mobile Safari
no live chat or after-hours capture
hiring a full-time treatment coordinator on Indeed
leads._expect: both channels available -> N3.5 falls through to the tenant preference

signals: Instagram bio links to a Linktree, not a booking system
posts 4x per week but no lead capture anywhere
leads._expect: no email and no linkedin_url -> N2 marks unreachable=True and every downstream node skips it

signals: class timetable is a static PDF updated in January
no Arabic version of the site despite an Arabic-language ad campaign
trial signup form emails a shared inbox with no autoresponder
leads._expect: language_map gives 'ar' -> N4 must localise the draft via translation.py

signals: three open Customer Success roles posted in the last 30 days
runs Intercom and HubSpot but no AI deflection layer
changelog shows a self-serve onboarding push in Q1
leads._expect: LinkedIn-only + EU region -> N3.5 chooses 'linkedin'; N5.5 applies the strictest compliance profile

signals: job posting for a Sales Development Rep mentions manual list building
uses Segment and Metabase per their engineering blog
raised a seed round in November per their press page
leads._expect: CASL region - N5.5 must confirm the required identification and opt-out line before any send
empty signals + role-based address -> N4 self-check must fail twice and flag for manual drafting rather than sending generic copy
deliberate near-duplicate of lead 1 (same domain, different casing/path/name) -> N1 dedupe must collapse it to the same lead_id

signals: reservation page is a mailto link with no calendar or availability
Google Business profile lists 212 reviews but no replies since 2025
site is French-only while their Instagram captions target English-speaking expats
leads._expect: EU + language_map gives 'fr' -> N4 must localise both the email and the LinkedIn note into French via translation.py, and N5.5 must still find the French opt-out line required by the EU compliance profile

suppressed_examples._expect: N5.5 must return blocked_optout for lead 2 on EVERY run and EVERY touch

reply_examples.reply_text: Thanks for reaching out - this is timely. Can you do a 20 minute call Thursday?
reply_examples._expect: interested -> exits the cadence immediately, next_action becomes a same-day manual follow-up

reply_examples.reply_text: Please remove me from your list and do not contact this address again.
reply_examples._expect: not_interested + explicit opt-out language -> auto-added to the suppression list without operator action

reply_examples.reply_text: I am currently out of the office until 14 March with limited access to email. For urgent matters contact reception.
reply_examples._expect: out_of_office -> excluded by the autoreply detector BEFORE classification; must not count as a real reply

reply_examples.reply_text: Wie sind Sie an meine Daten gekommen? Bitte nennen Sie mir Ihre Rechtsgrundlage nach DSGVO.
reply_examples._expect: objection with a compliance challenge -> suppress and route to manual handling
